newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish March CPI around 17 pct - finmin.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish March CPI around 17 pct - finmin.

text.p: Polish inflation should slow further in March after it fell to 17.3 percent year-on-year in February and could dip below 17 percent, Finance Minister Marek Belka said on Wednesday.

"We hope that the year-on-year inflation rate after hitting 17.3 percent (in February) will fall further in March and it is possible that it could be just below 17 percent," Belka told Reuters in an interview.
